body.purpose: Every readable string: Draft text, labels, timestamps, notes.

label.purpose: The code column, tabs, classification codes and field captions. 0.78em, tracked 0.16em, uppercase. The 11px floor — no label goes smaller.

shadows.name: failure-inset
shadows.purpose: A vermilion outline burned into a failure banner. The only shadow in the system; an alarm, not a lift.

components.name: Approve Button
components.description: The only control that reaches Slack. Always separated from Discard by a full rule.
components.css: .btn { font-family: inherit; font-size: inherit; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem; border: 2px solid var(--grid); background: transparent; color: var(--carbon); cursor: pointer; } .btn--approve { border-color: var(--signal); color: var(--signal); font-weight: 700; } .btn--approve:hover { background: var(--signal); color: var(--wall); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Save, Verify, Regenerate, Discard. Never adjacent to Approve.
components.css: .btn--secondary { color: var(--carbon-dim); } .btn--secondary:hover { color: var(--carbon); border-color: var(--carbon-dim); }

components.name: Credential Field
components.description: Secret input. Once stored the placeholder says so, so the field never implies it is empty.
components.css: input[type="text"], input[type="password"] { font-family: inherit; font-size: inherit; background: var(--wall); border: 1px solid var(--grid-soft); color: var(--carbon); padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; width: 100%; max-width: 34rem; } input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible { border-color: var(--signal); } input::placeholder { color: var(--carbon-faint); }

components.name: Draft Card
components.description: One unapproved Post. Flat, 2px rule, no shadow. The gap variant says NO SIGNAL in words rather than tinting the box.
components.css: .draft-card { border: 2px solid var(--grid); padding: 1.1rem 1.3rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.9rem; background: var(--wall-raised); } .draft-card__body { white-space: pre-wrap; min-height: 3.5rem; } .draft-card--nosignal .draft-card__body { color: var(--signal-dim); letter-spacing: 0.16em; font-weight: 700; border-left: 2px solid var(--signal-dim); padding-left: 0.7rem; }

components.name: Spine Row
components.description: One Fire in the timeline. The 3px strip carries status; the hatch carries a gap.
components.html:
14:30
Progress Update
SYS
No signal. Nothing collected between 14:30 and 18:30.
components.css: .fire { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 0.9rem 1rem 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grid-soft); } .fire__rule { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 3px; background: transparent; } .fire--traced .fire__rule { background: var(--signal); } .fire--failed .fire__rule { background: var(--sev1); } .fire__clock { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--carbon-dim); } .fire__name { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--carbon); } .fire__code { font-size: 0.78em; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--carbon-faint); overflow-wrap: anywhere; line-height: 1.35; } .fire--failed .fire__code { color: var(--sev1); font-weight: 700; } .hatch { height: 3px; margin-top: 0.55rem; border-radius: 1px; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--signal-dim) 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px); }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Three views. Selected is amber text with a 2px amber underline. No hamburger, no drawer.
components.css: .tabs { display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grid-soft); } .tab { font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.78em; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--carbon-faint); padding: 0 0 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; } .tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--signal); border-bottom-color: var(--signal); }

narrative.overview:
The instrument you read to know what a system did overnight. A board that could shout would be a board you could no longer trust, so this one takes up no attention at all: one type size, no radius except a single pixel on a hatch, no shadow except one inset alarm, and one amber mark whose rarity is the entire reason it is legible. Restraint is the mechanism here, not the mood.

A drawn gap means more than a filled one. When a window collected nothing, the surface shows a hatched void with the window's span printed across it, reading NO SIGNAL. That single gesture is the system's whole argument: a tool that cannot distinguish nothing happened from we did not look is a tool whose confident drafts mean nothing.
keyCharacteristics: One type size. Rank comes from weight, case, and rule — never a second size.
One amber, used on less than 5% of any screen. Its scarcity is the point.
Vermilion appears exactly once in the system: SEV1, a Fire that failed.
Depth is a rule and a slightly lighter ground, never a lift.
A gap is drawn as a gap.
rules: The One Voice Rule. Signal Amber is used on less than 5% of any screen.
The Vermilion Rule. Reserved for a failed Fire, and nothing else.
The AA Floor Rule. Every ink token clears 4.5:1 against its actual ground.
The One Size Rule. A second font size is a system bug.
The 11px Floor. Labels shrink to 0.78em and no further.
The Flat-By-Default Rule. Nothing rises, nothing glows, nothing has a drop shadow.
antiReferences: Near-black surfaces with a neon accent and glowing edges.
Card grids with pills, rounded corners and status chips.
Generated-dashboard tells: side-tab accent borders, decorative gradients, backdrop blur.
An optimistic surface that hides its gaps.
